hypotheses.claim: Loop regime and control decisions should be represented as typed IR/receipts carrying residual pressure, recurrence budget, timescale/cycle evidence and explicit halt/continue/route/escalate reason rather than inferred from state-delta alone.
hypotheses.support: 100000-case constructed discriminator plus 150000 invariant assertions; consistent with current loop directive and concurrent loop-network runtime result.
hypotheses.falsifier: Frozen H1/H2 traces show equivalent state/outcome/replay semantics when these fields are removed or collapsed to state-delta-only under a verified equivalence condition.

hypotheses.claim: LoopDynamicsReadout and LoopControlDecision are observation/control-routing semantics and must not directly carry or mint external effect authority.
hypotheses.support: Run-local effect checker rejected a CapabilityRef mutation; current ClayGraph/GWT/UnifiedDB authority boundaries independently require the same separation.
hypotheses.falsifier: A frozen architecture requirement demonstrates a necessary semantics-preserving case where readout identity itself must be an execution authority rather than merely reference a separately validated capability/effect contract.

hypotheses.claim: Current loop-of-loops requirements can be represented with existing generic G9 semantic constructs plus production structured-control/runtime lowering, without a FRANK-specific core loop primitive.
hypotheses.support: This run compiled the minimal readout/control candidate; concurrent project-authored loop-network and scheduler runs provide broader shared-ancestry support.
hypotheses.falsifier: A frozen H1 recurrent requirement cannot be parsed, typed, lowered, replayed or differentially matched in H2 without opaque host escape or semantic loss.

hypotheses.claim: Production halt/continue thresholds should be calibrated from H1 replay outcome/cost evidence rather than frozen from synthetic classifier thresholds.
hypotheses.support: External adaptive-depth literature and this run both separate representation of halting semantics from selection of a particular learned/fixed policy.
hypotheses.falsifier: A simpler policy proves invariant-equivalent and materially cheaper across frozen H1/H2 workloads and counterfactual controls.
